Product description

HMYC Original Car Upgrade Mazda Wired Carplay Box

The Mazda Carplay media hub is suitable for MZD CONNECT systems. Upgrade your car to a smart car and get Carplay and Android Auto functions. Enjoy music while driving, receive and send information, support Sirt and Google Assistant. Realize smart and safe driving.

You will enjoy Six Benefits while you having this Mazda Carplay Kit!

  • Support Wired Apple Carplay
  • Support Wired Android Auto
  • Support Voice Control and Hand-free Calling
  • Support Original Car Knob Control
  • Support Steering Wheel Operation
  • Support Touch Screen(for some car models, touch screen is not working while using Android Auto)

Why choose HMYC New P2 Upgraded Mazda Carplay HUB?

  • Faster connection speed with your cellphones.
  • Faster charging your devices while connecting your smart phones to the Hub’s USB port. Especially when you drive long distances, you will realize how important it is.


Smarter & Safer

Support your original car knob control and your original steering wheel button control, keep your drive more safety. Stay connected to your world while keeping your eyes focused on the road with our smartphone screen mirroring kit.


Support All Apps from Carplay/Android Auto

Supports IOS system and Android system, and SIRI and Google Assistant voice control can be perfectly adapted, which helps you focus on the road and enjoy along the way while getting directions, making calls, sending and receiving messages.


Package list

1 X Mazda HUB Unit

1 X USB Cable(Gray/Blue-Black)

1 X USB Cable(Gray/Blue-Brown)

1 X Sponge Tape (L=3m)

10 X Tie Wrap(L=200mm)

1 X Product Manuals

Perfect Compatibility

This carplay Adapter is suitable for Mazda Connect system, such as ：

Fits Mazda 2 2016-2019;

Fits Mazda 3 2014-2018;

Fits Mazda 6 2016-2020;

MX-5 2016-2020;

CX- 3 2016- 2019;

CX-5 2015-2020;

CX-9 2016-2020;

FIAT 124 2017- 2021.

And more

Warm Tips：

1.The software version of your car firmware system must be V70.00.21 or later

2.How to check your car firmware version?

Click the button “Setting”-“System”-“About”- “Version Information”- “OS Version”

3.How to upgrade your car firmware system?

Please refer to the upgrade method in the manual book.

<1>To prevent noise , wrap the disconnected vehicle wiring harness connector with a piece of sponge tape( 100 x 30 mm).

<2>The diagram shows the case when there is a single vehicle wiring harness connector.

<3>If there are two vehicle wiring harness connectors , carry out the same procedure for both connectors.

    I installed this last week. So far it has worked great. Picks up the device and auto starts android auto. The touch screen does not work while using android auto. I assume that is a limitation of the mazda unit as my touchscreen works fine outside of android auto. There are lots of videos on YouTube showing the fast/hack way to remove the device. My unit still worked and I didn't want to destroy it or my dash so I opted for the correct way to get it out. Deconstructing the center console. See the youtube channel "gear gadget experiments" if you have a mazda 3. Overall it wasn't too difficult. It took about 1.5-2 hours because I took my time and was very cautious not to break clips. This was my first time doing anything like this. Everything snapped back together and I don't have any rattles or loose pieces.

    Works very well ***Please note Firmware Caution before buying***

    Reviewed in the United States on June 18, 2025
    Color: Wired Carplay +Wired Android Auto
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    First, Prior to any installment of the Retro Fit item here, YOU MUST make sure your firmware is updated. There is an amazing forum for help with that on Mazda3 revolution, You will have to contact ASH8 for help, but it will give you a safe way to update your firmware.

    My Aux set up was tucked up front under the climate control, but I was able to find some good tutorials on how to swap it out without tearing out the whole front dash. Definitely use the foam tape that is sent, I covered the entire cord. My Apple play works great, it does not load every time, on start, but you can get it to connect manually.

    The only downside I found to the connection was the charging is very minimal, I'd describe it as a trickle charge. You won't get a lot of charge, but it will hold steady and not drop. For that you could always get a wireless dongle, and plug your phone into the cigarette lighter.

    Best purchase from Amazon ever! 70 bucks for this thing, then a $120 install from Best Buy, so for ~$200, I’ve got CarPlay plus new USB ports that power up my dash cam. The old USB ports had a trickle charge and wouldn’t even power up my dash cam. You will need to upgrade your firmware. For that go to YouTube and search for instruction vids by Killobyte. He also has one to change your settings to allow touchscreen functionality while driving, which comes in handy when using CarPlay. The connectivity to CarPlay is fast / instant once you plug in the USB cable (unlike some of my other vehicles), it works great and I am super happy with this. The technician at Best Buy said that it was easy to set up, and as far as fit is concerned, it fits exactly where the old USB module was located so I would say the fit is perfect. Now I can get rid of my cell phone mount and also the battery pack that I used to power up my dash cam.

    Recently I browsed through similar products to add Carplay to my Mazda CX-9 2016. The key words for it is "retrofit" kit.

    My thinking was that they don't seem to be so different, so why not choose something that's at a lower price (even though there are only a handful of reviews). Also the bottom line is, I never had a problem with Amazon return when things didn't work.

    I'm glad I purchased from "Jianzhen-us". Every single time they responded to my questions quickly, and with sufficient details to help with my installation and trying-out.

    The DIY installation process is not for a faint heart! But it saved me probably hundreds comparing to having it installed by a car shop.

    Also Mazda has its own set of weirdness, so with this item, touch screen didn't work with Android Auto at all (worked with Apple Car Play). I heard Mazda even got rid of touch screen altogether (no touch whatsoever for cars made in 2020 and after).

    I ended up buying another item from this store (https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0BMZMZF7J), which works well with this item (won't work without such a "retrofit" kit for older cars). Plus it allows YouTube and Netflix, etc. to be used, with touch screen. When the car starts moving, touch screen would still not work (it's a Mazda thing). But even I would agree it's not a good idea to try touch screen and distract oneself. So it's not a problem -- car knobs are to be used to operate the box while moving.

    Overall a hundred dollars plus hours of research/learning and installation got me a much better driving experience. It's a win. And I tend to think electronics, without being abused, generally do last for a reasonably long time. So I'm not too worried about that.

    I installed this is a 2015 Mazda CX5. The device came in very nice packaging and came with everything you need in the box, USB unit, wires, cable ties, foam covers and instructions. The USB hub you replace is an exact copy of the one in my car so once installed you wouldn't know you had replaced it except for a small phone icon on the unit.

    It was relatively easy to install. The hardest part is getting the USB unit out of the car as it has four clips holding it in. I pulled the front cover off the old unit with a hook tool and then used a flat head screwdriver to push the clips down. It was still hard to get it out but once out the rest is easy. There are YouTube videos with different techniques on how to get it out. Watch them and try the one you think you can do. Follow the the instructions that you get and you can't go wrong.

    It works perfectly and connects immediately. All the original Mazda controls work to control the CarPlay screen.

    This is a great update to a ten year old car which I would highly recommend.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Verified Purchase

    Funktioniert bisher einwandfrei auf Mazda3 2016

    Reviewed in Germany on September 28, 2024
    Color: Wired Carplay +Wired Android Auto
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Lieferumfang:

    - 2 Kabel, die vom Display durch die Verkleidung zum USB Hub verlegt werden müssen

    - der USB Hub

    - 9 Kabelbinder

    - 20 Stücke Schaumstofftape, jeweils 100mmx30mm

    Einbau:

    Schwierigkeit einfach bis mittel, ca 1h ohne das Softwareupdate.

    Es musste nur eine Schraube (10mm Außensechskant), mit der das Display zusätzlich befestigt ist, gelöst werden. Der Rest sind Steckverbindungen, die man vorsichtig aber mit beherzter Kraft problemlos lösen kann. Der Raum hinter dem Display ist sehr eng, die Kabel zu verlegen eine kleine Herausforderung. Geht auf jeden Fall von oben nach unten vor, von unten eine Öffnung zu finden ist praktisch unmöglich. Die Anschlüsse sind zwar selbsterklärend und unmöglich falsch zu verkabeln, einem sollte aber vor dem Verlegen genau klar sein, welcher Stecker auf welche Seite gehört.

    Das Schaumstofftape reicht um (fast) die gesamten Kabel zu polstern. Ein oder zwei Stücke übrig zu lassen, um die alten Stecker gegen Rattern abzukleben, macht Sinn, weil man das alte Kabel am Kabelbaum lässt.

    Software:

    ACHTUNG! Die Firmware der "Head Unit" (des Displays und seinem Computer) muss mindestens Version 70.00.100A oder höher sein BEVOR man den neuen Hub einbaut. (Kann man unter Einstellungen->System->Über->Version Information nachsehen)

    Nochmal ACHTUNG: Führt ein notwendiges Update auf keinen Fall nach der beilegten Anleitung durch! Das kann die Unit komplett unbrauchbar machen.

    Wer das generelle Risiko eingehen möchte, kann jedoch auf eine 9-seitige bebilderte Anleitung, die im Internet kursiert, zurückgreifen, der haargenau gefolgt werden sollte. Bei mir hat es ohne Probleme geklappt.

    Bisher nur Android Auto getestet. Es läuft flüssig und tut was es soll.

    Fazit:

    Wer nicht zwei linke Hände oder große Angst davor hat, etwas kaputt zu machen, kann den Einbau locker selbst machen. Apple Carplay und Android Auto sind deutlich moderner als Mazda Connect und bessere Navigation als mit Google Maps findet man 2024 nicht.

Product Description

CarPlay Android Auto Retrofit Kit Fits for Mazda 3 6 CX-5 CX-3 MX-5 Miata Replaces TK78-66-9U0C Function: Stay connected to your world while keeping your eyes focused on the road with our smartphone screen mirroring kit. This upgrade kit enhances the MAZDA CONNECT infotainment system with CarPlay allowing you to access your iPhone’s maps, playlists, contacts and compatible apps with your voice through Siri. Siri will also read incoming text messages and allow you to reply without taking your hands off the wheel. You can also navigate the features of CarPlay with the optimally positioned multifunction Commander control. For Android users, this upgrade also adds Android Auto functionality. Compatible with: CX-3 All models 2016 to 2019 CX-5 All models 2016 to 2017 CX-9 All models 2016 to 2020 Mazda3 4-Door All models 2014 to 2018 Mazda3 5-Door All models 2014 to 2018 Mazda6 All models 2016 to 2020 MX-5 Miata Club / Grand Touring 2016 to 2020 MX-5 Miata RF Sport 2018 to 2019 MX-5 Miata Sport 2018 to 2020 Important Notice: MAZDA CONNECT unit NOT include. Software update NOT included The firmware MUST BE UPDATED FIRST before beginning the installation. If an older version of the CMU software is being used, the CarPlay/Android Auto-compatible USB hub may not be recognized. The software must be v70.00.21 or later. If not be sure to update the software. Once the CMU has been attached to the CarPlay/Android Auto-compatible USB hub, the software cannot be updated. These work on Mazda models that have MAZDA CONNECT. If you do not have a Mazda connect unit in your Mazda these will not work.
